title: Demo loads without login and identifies sample data
description: Target is http://localhost:8799/ in --demo mode; do not attempt /login or use credentials.

steps.description: Open / and wait for initial content
Page renders health, KPIs, activity, scores, decisions and MODO DEMO banner; it must not claim to show live Sensor1 data

title: Polling keeps operational dashboard responsive
description: Exercise one 5-second refresh; zero sample traffic is expected and must not be invented.

steps.description: Open / and wait at least 6 seconds
No browser JavaScript error or failed /api/status, /api/score-histogram requests; health and KPI cards remain rendered

title: All seven system views render in development mode
description: Demo has an admin-like UI; this does not verify live admin authorization.

steps.description: Open /, click Modo operativo to switch to Modo desarrollo, then visit each of the seven tabs under Mapa del sistema
Each view changes the map or validation table, and shows a relevant detail panel without a blank diagram or JS error

title: Declared source code opens in read-only modal
description: Follow the actual interaction path: Ver archivos, component, file, Ver contenido.

steps.description: In Modo desarrollo choose Operacional, click Ver archivos, choose Motor, open a declared Python file, then click Ver contenido
Modal displays text content, not an editable control; close it via Escape and continue navigating

title: Unknown file path is denied by the API
description: Do not use passwords or request private files; a nonexistent test path suffices.

steps.description: Response status is 403 and no file content is returned

title: Guided tour opens and can be dismissed
description: The tour should not prevent subsequent navigation.

steps.description: Open /, click Guía, advance once and close the tour
Tour overlay disappears and dashboard controls remain usable

title: Activity range selectors handle empty demo traffic
description: Demo is not expected to have real events.

steps.description: Open /, select Última hora and Últimas 24h in Actividad
Axes/range update without errors; no fabricated live events appear

title: Model and Suricata comparison state their scope
description: Check labels and limitations rather than trying to reproduce attacks from the demo.

steps.description: Switch to Modo desarrollo and visit Modelo and Suricata sections
Active model is IsolationForest, not OCSVM; comparison scope and limitations are visible

title: Mobile viewport does not scale the entire document
description: Known candidate defect: at 390px visual width, document measured 574px in local Chromium; report accurately if reproduced.

steps.description: Document width does not exceed visual viewport; menu may scroll in its own region while KPI text stays legible
